ct_tip: If the meter is configured with a CT/CTs, 'CT' button needs to be ticked, then, the CT ratio can be edited. P.S. only for Acrel ADL3000 CT meter or ACR10R CT meter, the 'CT' button should be ticked.
meter_ct_rate: the rated magnification ratio of CT
meter_on_grid_tips: In grid connected system, if a meter is installed on the grid side, please click the 'meter' button. If a CT is connected on the grid side directly, please click the 'CT' button.
meter_on_pv_tips: In AC-/ hybrid-coupled work mode, if a meter is installed on the PV-inverter side, please click the 'meter' button . If a CT is directly connected on PV-inverter side, please click the 'CT' button.
